What happened

The weekly drone inspection INS-0189-0044 at 13:45 on 2023-08-17 found crude oil on the pad: about 2.6% of the pad area, estimated 1.3 bbl. The inspector noted: "Dark staining on pad." The field operator shut the well in, closed the flowline valve and placed earth berms and absorbent pads. The release was contained about 3.7 hours after the inspection. The crew traced the leak to a threaded coupling on the flowline close to the wellhead.

Root cause

Thread fatigue from pump jack vibration.

Safety and permits

  • Pre-job safety meeting held with the crew before work started (WS-01).

Work done

  1. Excavated around the coupling.
